name: full vambraces
_design_note: F50-100 heavy arms slot. Full articulated plate, elbow couter and forearm rerebrace. Pairs with plate/full plate body. Vambraces_of_Achilles uses this as template_basis.
lore_template: With gauntlets, these full {material_name} vambraces sheathe the arm from fingertip to shoulder, having a hinged cup at the elbow and a fluted plate above it. Upon the inner seam the smith has set his mark, where it is likely that the wearer will never look.
